q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis of NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance

## (a) Time left until resolution
The earnings release is scheduled for August 26, 2026. Today is August 20, 2026. That's **6 days** until the company provides forward guidance for Q3 FY2027.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

NVIDIA previously guided Q2 FY2027 revenue at **$91.0 billion ± 2%** (so a range of $89.18B to $92.82B). In Q1 FY2027, they reported $81.6B in revenue.

For **Q3 FY2027 guidance** (which will be announced with Q2 earnings on August 26):
- Current consensus is **$103.1 billion** per the research provided
- This represents approximately 13% sequential growth from the Q2 midpoint of $91B
- This growth rate is consistent with NVIDIA's recent trajectory (Q1→Q2 shows ~11.6% sequential growth from $81.6B to $91B)

The most likely outcome is that NVIDIA's **Q3 FY2027 forward guidance will be in the range of 100-106 billion dollars**, centered around the consensus estimate of $103.1B. This reflects:
- Continued strength in data center AI demand
- Normal sequential growth patterns established in recent quarters
- Analyst consensus alignment

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- Weaker than expected Q2 actual results (miss on current guidance)
- Signs of AI CapEx deceleration or customer push-outs
- Increased China revenue restrictions beyond current assumptions
- Macro economic deterioration affecting cloud/enterprise spending
- Changes to the China revenue assumptions that reduce the guidance base
- Market perception of AI demand plateau

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- Q2 significantly beats guidance (management has shown willingness to raise)
- Acceleration in data center demand faster than expected
- Better visibility into H2 2026 enterprise and cloud spending
- Success/early adoption of new Vera CPU driving higher blended revenue
- Customer acceleration due to competitive dynamics
- Expansion of AI workloads into new verticals
- Management commentary indicating sustained CapEx cycle strength

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

From the research provided:
- Q1 FY2027: $81.6B actual (beat guidance midpoint by 4.6%)
- Q2 FY2027 guidance: $91.0B ± 2% (this was the prior guidance)
- Q3 FY2027 consensus: $103.1B
- Historical pattern: NVIDIA has recently shown ~11-13% sequential growth and tendency to beat guidance

Sequential growth rates:
- Q1→Q2: $81.6B → $91.0B guidance midpoint = ~11.5% growth
- Expected Q2→Q3 growth implied by consensus: ~13.2% growth

## Estimate Rationale

The question asks specifically for "forward guidance in Q2 FY2027 earnings release" for Q3 FY2027 revenue. The research shows current consensus is $103.1B. Given:

1. NVIDIA's recent track record of beating guidance (Q1 beat by 4.6%)
2. The sequential growth trend of 11-13% is sustainable based on recent performance
3. Analyst consensus at $103.1B suggests market expects management to guide around this level
4. The range provided (99.5-115.5B) is wide, suggesting high uncertainty
5. Six days until release provides almost no new information

I expect management to provide guidance within 1-3% of current consensus, likely in the $100-106B range. There's upside risk if Q2 beats and management raises Q3 outlook, and downside risk if there are demand signals that warrant caution.

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q3 FY2027 revenue, which will be released with the Q2 FY2027 earnings report on August 26, 2026, is a key focus for analysts. Consensus revenue for Q3 FY2027 is currently $103.1 billion [rexshares.com](https://www.rexshares.com/nvidia-earnings/).

For Q2 FY2027, NVIDIA previously guided revenue to $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%, excluding any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/) [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html). This compares to an average analyst estimate of $91.85 billion for Q2 FY2027 [rexshares.com](https://www.rexshares.com/nvidia-earnings/) [hudson-labs.com](https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/nvidia-q2-2027-earnings-preview-nvda-revenue-guidance-key-factors/). In Q1 FY2027, NVIDIA reported $81.6 billion in revenue, beating its own guidance midpoint by 4.6% [rexshares.com](https://www.rexshares.com/nvidia-earnings/).

The Q3 FY2027 guide is particularly important as it indicates whether the capital expenditure curve for AI is still expanding [rexshares.com](https://www.rexshares.com/nvidia-earnings/). Analysts will also be watching for any changes to the China revenue assumption in the Q3 guidance [rexshares.com](https://www.rexshares.com/nvidia-earnings/). NVIDIA CFO Colette Kress anticipates $20 billion in total CPU revenue this year, partly driven by the new Vera CPU [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html).
